descFull: px0 is a fast, lightweight, read-only IDE designed for instant code navigation and review in your browser. Booting in under 1 ms and using ~20 MB of RAM, it turns your browser into a zero-latency inspection console with symbol-level navigation, deep search, and syntax highlighting across massive codebases.
